findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_shipping_quote, find_drop_off_points · Private data: list_shipments, get_shipment · Public sink: track_package, get_shipping_quote, find_drop_off_points, compare_shipping_rates · Destructive: find_drop_off_points, list_addresses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_shipping_quote, find_drop_off_points · Private data: list_shipments, get_shipment · Public sink: track_package, get_shipping_quote, find_drop_off_points, compare_shipping_rates · Destructive: find_drop_off_points, list_addresses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
